label: Cyberpunk RED
description: The Time of the Red. A post-4th Corporate War dark future of edgerunners, megacorps, gangs, Nomad packs, Netrunners and desperate survivors fighting to make a life in Night City.
tldr: Cyberpunk RED — skills, firearms, cyberware, humanity and Role Abilities define your character. There are ten Roles: Rockerboy, Solo, Netrunner, Tech, Medtech, Media, Exec, Lawman, Fixer and Nomad. Roles provide Role Abilities rather than a conventional subclass system, and RED supports changing Roles during play.

links.data_api: no public data API — local profile only

races.North American: Raised in the fractured remains of the old United States and its successor territories. You know the language, customs and scars of the continent.
races.South/Central American: You grew up amid the cultures and communities of Central or South America, carrying traditions, languages and connections into the Time of the Red.
races.European: You come from one of the many cultures of Europe, where old-world traditions coexist with corporate power and a rapidly changing future.
races.Soviet: Your upbringing was shaped by the Soviet sphere and its surviving communities, institutions and traditions.
races.African: You grew up within one of Africa's many cultures and communities, bringing your own history and perspective into the fractured world of 2045.
races.Middle Eastern: Your roots lie in the diverse cultures of the Middle East, carrying family traditions and history into the Dark Future.
races.South Asian: Your upbringing comes from the diverse cultures of South Asia, where old traditions and new technology exist side by side.
races.East Asian: You were raised within the cultures of East Asia, surrounded by ancient traditions, modern technology and the influence of powerful corporations.
races.Southeast Asian: Your roots are in the cultures of Southeast Asia, carrying a mixture of old traditions and modern survival skills into the Time of the Red.

classes.Rockerboy: You use art, music, performance and personality to influence people. Rockerboys can inspire crowds, challenge authority and turn attention into power.
classes.Solo: A professional combatant who survives by knowing when to fight, where to stand and how to end a fight before it ends them.
classes.Netrunner: You jack directly into NET Architectures and fight through digital defenses. Data, Interface and quick thinking are your weapons.
classes.Tech: You build, repair, upgrade and invent. Your hands can turn scrap into working technology and working technology into something better.
classes.Medtech: You keep people alive in a world where medical care is expensive, scarce or controlled by corporations. Surgery, pharmaceuticals and cryotechnology are your tools.
classes.Media: You investigate, gather rumors and expose information. Your credibility and your story can change what people believe about the world around them.
classes.Exec: You operate inside the corporate world. Your position gives you access to resources, a team and corporate support, but also obligations and enemies.
classes.Lawman: You work within or around the law, calling on backup when things become dangerous. You might be corporate security, police, federal law enforcement or another kind of authority.
classes.Fixer: You connect people, information, services and goods. Contacts and negotiation are your currency, and you know where to find what people need.
classes.Nomad: Your family or pack is your foundation. You understand vehicles, logistics and the roads between communities, and you can move people and goods when almost nobody else can.
